overview: The 2026 manual reflects major changes to licensing and testing, including REAL ID versus Standard cards, vertical licenses for those under 21, tougher Junior Operator rules (more supervised driving hours, parental instruction, a stricter night curfew, and a full ban on mobile devices for drivers under 18), and updated road test requirements like a 72-hour cancellation notice and a parking-brake check. It also introduces stronger distracted-driving laws such as the hands-free mobile device requirement, along with many new road-safety topics including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, the four-foot bicycle passing rule and Dutch Reach method, roundabouts, the Move-Over Law, drowsy driving, and recommended car safety kits. Drivers should also review numerous new and expanded rules for bicycles, motorized scooters, low-speed and limited-use vehicles, pedestrian signals like the Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon and countdown timers, and updated procedures for tunnels, backing up, three-point turns, and breakdown safety. Finally, expect higher fees, fines, and penalties across the board, plus revised OUI consequences, ignition interlock requirements, new suspension reasons, and updated insurance and at-fault thresholds.

sections.title: REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts Cards
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts card distinction required for federal purposes, which did not exist in 2002.
bullets: "You need a REAL ID, or other acceptable ID such as a valid passport, to fly within the United States or enter certain federal buildings. A REAL ID Card issued by Massachusetts is compliant with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Facial Image Policy
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a detailed facial image policy specifying acceptable appearance for photo capture, which is not in the 2002 edition.
bullets: "A solid or transparent facial cover (scarf, veil, eyeglasses/sunglasses, goggles, surgical or dust mask, etc.) is not acceptable. Eyeglasses, including reading or prescription glasses, are not allowed, even if the applicant normally wears them." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State Program
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the State-to-State program that cancels licenses/ID cards issued by other participating states, which is not present in 2002.
bullets: "Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states. State-to-State will cancel any driver's license or state issued ID card issued by the other participating state when a Massachusetts license or ID Card (excluding a Liquor ID) is issued." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Driver Education and Training Requirements
sections.description: The required in-car behind-the-wheel training and additional supervised driving hours for a JOL increased from 2002 levels.
bullets: "Successfully complete an RMV-approved driver education and training program, which includes 30 hours of classroom instruction; 12 hours of in-car, behind-the-wheel training; and six hours of in-car experience observing other student drivers." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Complete at least an additional 40 hours of supervised, behind-the-wheel driving as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Parent/Guardian Instruction Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement that a parent or guardian participate in two hours of instruction on the driver's education curriculum, which is not in 2002.
bullets: "A parent or guardian must participate in two hours of instruction on the driver's education curriculum (unless they have participated within the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Night Operating Restriction Time
sections.description: The JOL night driving restriction start time changed from 12:00 a.m. in 2002 to 12:30 a.m. in 2026.
bullets: "As the holder of a JOL, you may not operate a motor vehicle between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. unless you are accompanied by one of your parents or your legal guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Restriction Violation Suspension Penalties
sections.description: The suspension periods for violating JOL passenger/night restrictions increased from 30/60/90 days in 2002 to 60 days/180 days/one year in 2026, with an added retraining requirement.
bullets: "If you violate the passenger restriction or the night restriction, you will be subject to a license suspension of 60 days for a first offense, 180 days for a second offense, and one year for subsequent offenses. For a second or subsequent offense, you will also be required to complete a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Speeding and Drag Racing Suspension Periods
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies updated suspension periods for JOL drag racing and speeding offenses differing from the 2002 framework.
bullets: "You will face additional suspension periods of one year for a first drag racing offense and three years for a subsequent offense. For a first speeding offense, you will be suspended for 90 days; for a subsequent offense, you will be suspended for one year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Mobile Electronic Device Ban
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits drivers under 18 from using any mobile electronic device while driving, a restriction not present in the 2002 edition.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 may not use any mobile electronic device for any reason while operating a motor vehicle. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-Country Driving Violation Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies that a violation of Section 10 (out-of-country driving rules) is a criminal violation subject to a $500 fine, which the 2002 edition did not state.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vertical License/ID for Under 21
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces vertical-format licenses/ID cards for those under 21, which is not present in the 2002 edition.
bullets: "If you renew your license or ID card before your 21st birthday, you will receive a vertical license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ten-Year State Licensing History Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires applicants to provide a list of states licensed in for the past ten years and all out-of-state license numbers, which is not required in 2002.
bullets: "When you apply for a permit or license, or renew a license, you will be required to provide a list of the states you have been licensed in for the past ten years, as well as all out-of-state license numbers you have had." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Expanded List of License Restriction Codes
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides a greatly expanded list of license restriction code letters, including ignition interlock, bioptic telescoping lens, and CDL-specific restrictions not detailed in 2002.
bullets: "T Ignition Interlock" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"R Bioptic Telescoping Lens" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Electronic Identification Document Verification
sections.description: The 2026 manual describes an electronic checks process for verifying identification documents with national and state databases, which is not in the 2002 edition.
bullets: "The Registry will initiate electronic checks for most identification documents with national and state databases. This process provides validity responses back to the RMV within seconds for the vast majority." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Learner's Permit Exam Fee
sections.description: The learner's permit exam fee increased from $15 to $30.
bullets: "Pay a $30 learner’s permit exam fee, which covers the cost of your exam." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Each learner’s permit exam has 25 multiple-choice questions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"To pass the exam, you must answer 18 questions correctly within the allotted time of 25 minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Supervised Driving Hours for Driver's Education
sections.description: Required supervised driving increased from 12 hours to 40 hours (30 hours with a driver skills development program), and parents must now participate in two hours of the curriculum.
bullets: "You must also complete 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program), and your parent or guardian must participate in two hours of the driver’s education curriculum (unless he/she already attended in the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Insurance Coverage Limits
sections.description: Out-of-state vehicle insurance minimums increased from $20,000/$40,000 bodily injury and $5,000 property damage to $25,000/$50,000 bodily injury and $30,000 property damage.
bullets: "If your test vehicle is registered out of state, you must show the examiner proof of insurance coverage equal to Massachusetts minimum limits, which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Board of Appeals Fee
sections.description: The appeal filing fee increased from $25 to $50.
bullets: "A formal appeal may be filed only with the Board of Appeals on Liability Policies and Bonds at the address below with a check or money order for $50." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation/Reschedule Notice
sections.description: The notice required to cancel or reschedule a road test without a fee increased from 24 hours to 72 hours.
bullets: "There is no additional fee if you cancel or reschedule with more than 72 hours notice." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Retake Waiting Period
sections.description: A new 14-day waiting period is required before retaking a failed or missed road test.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests
sections.description: New criteria allow examiners to reject road tests for signs of impairment, odor of alcohol or cannabis, or unsupervised minors/animals in the vehicle.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Minor children, babies, or animals are present in the vehicle and cannot be left unsupervised at the Service Center. Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Sponsor Limit
sections.description: A new restriction limits sponsors to no more than three different applicants within a one-year period without RMV approval.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Brake for Road Test
sections.description: The road test now requires an accessible parking brake (manual or electric) rather than a foot brake or emergency hand brake, with specific RPM testing requirements.
bullets: "An accessible parking brake so the examiner can make an emergency stop. The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Donut Tire Prohibition
sections.description: A new rule prohibits using a vehicle with a limited-use spare 'donut' tire for the road test.
bullets: "A vehicle cannot be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a "donut" (limited use spare) tire." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Repair, Dealer, and Farm Plate Restrictions
sections.description: New restrictions govern using vehicles with dealer, farm, or repair plates for the road test.
bullets: "You will not be allowed to take a road test in a vehicle with a repair plate." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You cannot take a road test in a passenger vehicle that is registered with a "dealer" plate unless you can prove, to the satisfaction of the examiner, that you are the dealer, or spouse of the dealer, or a salesperson who works at the dealership." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Vehicle Features in Road Test
sections.description: New guidance addresses modern vehicle features like back-up cameras and automatic parallel parking, which need not be disabled but will not be relied upon during testing.
bullets: "These features substantially assist a driver with certain driving, parking, or backing skills. These devices will not need to be disabled. However, your driving skills and abilities without relying only on these specialized features will be tested." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M Road Test for Under 18
sections.description: Applicants under 18 are no longer eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course.
bullets: "If you are under 18 years old, you are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to get a Class M license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Social Security Number Affidavit
sections.description: A new option allows applicants without an SSN to present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License.
bullets: "If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Testing Accommodations
sections.description: Expanded reasonable accommodation options including extended time and a designated reader for those with cognitive or physical disabilities.
bullets: "If you have a cognitive or physical disability that would prevent you from taking a standard exam, you may request a reasonable accommodation, which could include: • Extended time • Reader" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License and Permit Fees
sections.description: Multiple license-related fees increased from the 2002 amounts.
bullets: "Learner’s permit exam fee - $30.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Road test fee - $35.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"License issue/renew fee - Class D - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Duplicate or amended license - $25.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation Notice Period
sections.description: The cancellation notice window to avoid forfeiting the road test fee increased from 24 hours to 72 hours.
bullets: "are rejected by the examiner, or cancel your appointment with less than 72 hours notice, you will still be charged the $35 fee" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Child Passenger Restraint Requirements
sections.description: The age/height threshold for requiring child passenger restraints changed from age 12 or under to at least eight years old or fifty-seven inches tall.
bullets: "Infants and small children must sit in federally approved child passenger restraints until they... 1. Are at least eight years old or 2. At least fifty-seven inches tall" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator License Conversion Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: The required supervised driving hours for a Junior Operator license conversion increased from 12 hours to 40 hours.
bullets: "you must log an additional 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual references a hands-free mobile phone use law, whereas the 2002 manual permitted cellular phone use with one hand on the wheel.
bullets: "For information on the use of mobile (cell) phones and other mobile electronic devices, see the Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use section below." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator on License/ID
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the option to print a Veteran's Indicator on a license or ID, which did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "If you are a veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged, you can choose to have the word \"Veteran\" printed on your license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Animals in Vehicle During Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual newly permits trained service animals but prohibits emotional support animals in the vehicle during a road test.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Inside Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance to avoid loud noise levels so emergency sirens can be heard, which was not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphone Use Exception
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an exception allowing those 18 or older to use one earplug with a cell phone, which was not present in the 2002 ban.
bullets: "If you are 18 or older, you can use one earplug for use with a cell phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Lights on Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual newly states that emergency lights are not allowed without an RMV permit.
bullets: "Emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe lights) are not allowed on a vehicle unless you get a permit from the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a recommended car safety kit list, which did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool • White and red cloths to tie to your vehicle during a breakdown" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Organ and Tissue Donor Registry
sections.description: The 2026 organ donor program uses an online Massachusetts Donor Registry with a heart symbol on the license and an optional $2 donation, replacing the 2002 paper donor card process.
bullets: "By registering as an organ and tissue donor with the RMV, you will be entered into the Massachusetts Donor Registry, which is legal consent for donation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated process for scheduling road tests with interpreter arrangements for deaf or hard of hearing applicants.
bullets: "If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can schedule a road test by calling 1-877-RMV-TTDD (1-877-768-8833)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Electronic Device Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits hand-held mobile electronic device use while driving, whereas the 2002 manual permitted cellular phone use with one hand on the wheel.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands­ free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Total Device Ban for Drivers Under 18
sections.description: The 2026 manual bars drivers under 18 from using any mobile electronic device for any reason except emergencies.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 cannot use any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Hand-Held Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes a graduated fine structure for using a hand-held mobile electronic device while driving.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a Vulnerable Road Users Law requiring a minimum four-foot passing distance, which is absent from the 2002 manual.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) not present in 2002.
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated Drowsy Driving section with statistics and prevention guidance not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "The ONLY true way to protect yourself from drowsy driving is to get enough sleep and to not drive when you feel tired." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Second Following Rule
sections.description: The 2026 manual increases the basic following-distance rule from two seconds to three seconds and adds graduated distances for motorcycles and heavy equipment.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least four seconds) behind a motorcycle than you would for another vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least ten seconds) between your vehicle and heavy equipment (for example, dump trucks, tractors)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tailgating Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a fine for tailgating that the 2002 manual did not state.
bullets: "Tailgating is illegal and the main cause of rear-end crashes. The fine for tailgating can be as high as $100." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Visibility Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific requirement that the plate number be visible from 60 feet at night.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Updated Stopping Distance Figures
sections.description: The 2026 manual revises the braking and total stopping distance figures used in the educational example.
bullets: "Once you hit the brakes, you may go another 160 feet or more before you stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"At 60 mph, it takes about 292 feet (almost a whole football field) to react to a hazard, step on the brake, and safely stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headlight Use in Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands headlight requirements to include driving through a tunnel and seeing people/vehicles 500 feet ahead.
bullets: "While driving through a tunnel" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"When you cannot clearly see people or vehicles 500 feet ahead due to insufficient light or weather conditions" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penny Tire Tread Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the penny test method for checking tire tread depth, not described in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "is to slide a penny into a tread groove . If you can see the top of Lincoln’s head, your tires are worn out ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Snow Removal and Negligent Operation
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands winter driving rules to require clearing the roof, hood, and trunk and warns of negligent operation charges.
bullets: "Remove ALL ice and snow from your vehicle before driving. Clear all windows, windshield wipers, headlights, and brake lights. It is very important that you clear the roof, hood, and trunk so ice and snow does not blow into vehicles behind you. If you do not, you can be charged with negligent operation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorized Scooter Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules and penalties for operating motorized scooters, a topic absent from the 2002 manual.
bullets: "A motorized scooter is any two or three-wheeled vehicle with handlebars and an electric or gas motor that can move the vehicle with or without human propulsion." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You can be fined up to $25 (1st Offense); $25-$50 (2nd Offense); $50-$100 (3rd + Offense)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limited Use Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new vehicle category for limited use vehicles that can travel faster than 30 mph but not more than 40 mph.
bullets: "A limited use vehicle can have two or more wheels. It can go faster than 30 mph, but not more than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot drive a limited use vehicle on a limited-access or express state highway or any road with a speed limit faster than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Low Speed Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for Low Speed Vehicles (LSV), a category not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) has four wheels and can only go between 20 and 25 mph. It must have a gross weight rating lower than 3,000 lbs." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot drive a low speed vehicle on a limited access or express state highway or any road with a speed limit faster than 30 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Safety Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds updated bicycle safety laws placing responsibility on bicyclists, motorists, and bicycle renters, and allows police to cite bicyclists.
bullets: "If a police officer sees a bicyclist commit a traffic violation, the officer can issue a citation the same way they would for a motorist." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Companies that rent bicycles must offer helmets that meet all safety requirements for renters." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Infraction Hearing Filing Fee and Surcharge
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $25 hearing filing fee and a $5 public safety surcharge for civil motor vehicle infractions that did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Every fine for a CMVI that comes from Chapter 89 or 90 of the Massachusetts General Laws will have an added $5 public safety surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you request a hearing, you must pay a $25 filing fee to the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Speeding Violation Penalties
sections.description: The minimum speeding fine increased from $75 to $100, the Head Injury Trust Fund surcharge increased from $25 to $50, and a new $5 public safety surcharge was added.
bullets: "The lowest penalty for driving above the speed limit is a $100 fine, plus an additional $5 public safety surcharge which is added to all speeding violations." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"By law, all fines for speeding violations include a $50 surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Threshold
sections.description: The claim payment threshold for being considered more than 50 percent at fault increased from more than $500 to more than $1000, and a new bodily injury threshold was added.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else's property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury (if there is no collision or damage to someone else's property over $1000 from the same incident)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Retraining Course Threshold
sections.description: The threshold for mandatory driver retraining decreased from five or more surchargeable events to three or more within a two-year period.
bullets: "If you get three or more surchargeable events on your driving record within a two-year period, you must complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Record Cost
sections.description: The cost of an attested driving record increased from $10 to $20, and a new unattested record option for $8 was added.
bullets: "The cost of an attested driving record is $20." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you do not need the driving record to be attested, you can order an unattested driving record for $8 (this option is only available online)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Violation Reinstatement Fee
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a minimum $100 reinstatement fee for out-of-state suspensions, where the 2002 manual cited $50.
bullets: "If your driving privileges are suspended, you must present proof to the RMV that you resolved your out-of-state obligations, and pay a reinstatement fee (minimum of $100) to Massachusetts before your Massachusetts license can be reinstated." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorcycle Following Distance
sections.description: The recommended following distance behind a motorcycle changed; the 2026 manual states a four-second distance compared to three seconds for other vehicles, while the 2002 manual used four seconds compared to two seconds.
bullets: "Use a four-second following distance (compared to a three-second for other motor vehicles)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mandatory License Suspension Reinstatement Fees
sections.description: Reinstatement fees for mandatory license suspensions increased, with the common fee rising from $50 to $100.
bullets: "License has been suspended or revoked in another state. Until the out-of-state suspension is resolved $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Devices
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement for Ignition Interlock Devices for repeat OUI offenders that does not appear in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "If you had two or more operating under the influence offenses and are eligible for a hardship license or for license reinstatement, you must have an Ignition Interlock Device. It must be attached to your motor vehicle at your expense." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI License Reinstatement Fees
sections.description: The reinstatement fees for OUI convictions were increased from the 2002 amounts.
bullets: "One year (first) Two years (second) Eight years (third) Ten years (fourth) Lifetime (fifth) $500 (first) $700 (second) $1200 (third) $1200 (fourth)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI Penalty Fines
sections.description: The fine amounts for OUI offenses were revised with specified minimums and maximums in the 2026 manual.
bullets: "$500–$5,000 Maximum 2 1/2 years One Year" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"$600–$10,000 Minimum 30 days Maximum 2 1/2 years Two years" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Graffiti/Defacing Property
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a license suspension for defacing property or applying graffiti that does not appear in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Defacing real or personal property, spraying paint or applying stickers or other graffiti (Operation of a ve­ hicle is not required) One year (or delay of one year in obtaining a License) $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drug Trafficking License Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual lists a specific drug trafficking related suspension as a criminal offense category not detailed in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Any drug trafficking related conviction (except a Class D substance) (Operation of a vehicle is not required) One–Five years $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a suspension for negligent operation and injury from mobile phone use, not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use 60 days–One year $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Unpaid Income Tax and Other Reasons
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds new non-driving reasons for license suspension including failure to pay income tax, failure to register as a sex offender, and bad payments to the RMV.
bullets: "Have failed to register as a sex offender" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Have failed to pay Massachusetts income tax" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Have made a bad payment to the RMV (for example, you paid with a check that was later rejected or you paid with a credit card and later canceled the payment with the bank)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vehicular Manslaughter Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds vehicular manslaughter as a separate criminal offense with a 15-year to lifetime suspension, not listed separately in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Vehicular manslaughter 15 years–Lifetime $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motor Vehicle Homicide Suspension Period
sections.description: The suspension period for motor vehicle homicide changed from 10 years–Lifetime in 2002 to 15 years–Lifetime in 2026.
bullets: "Motor vehicle homicide 15 years–Lifetime $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Buying Alcohol Under 21 Penalty
sections.description: The 2002 manual specified an increased 180-day suspension for buying alcohol under 21; the 2026 manual states a 90-day to one-year suspension without the 180-day increase reference.
bullets: "Your license will be suspended for 90 days to one year for breaking either of these laws." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension Periods for Failed Chemical Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides detailed suspension periods for failed chemical tests by age group with specific statutory references not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Drivers over age 21 License is suspended for 30 days or until the conclusion of the court case, whichever is shorter." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers age 18 to 21 License is suspended for 30 days, plus an additional 180 days, pursuant to MGL c.90, s. 24P." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension Periods for Refusing a Chemical Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides updated and detailed refusal suspension periods by age and prior offenses with additional age-based suspensions.
bullets: "Drivers over age 21 No Prior OUI Offenses 180 days One Prior OUI Offense Three years Two Prior OUI Offenses Five years Three or More Prior OUI Offenses Lifetime" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol and Marijuana Combined Crash Risk
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific statistics on crash risk increases from alcohol and combined alcohol/marijuana use not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Alchohol use makes the risk of a crash five times more likely. Alcohol use combined with marijuana use makes the risk of a crash twelve times more likely." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Safe Ride Options
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds advice about designated drivers and rideshare apps not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Appoint a designated driver, take a taxi, use a rideshare app like Uber or Lyft, or call a friend or family member for a ride." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol Highway Death Statistics
sections.description: The 2002 manual stated alcohol is responsible for half of all highway deaths; the 2026 manual revises this to about 30%.
bullets: "Each year in the United States, alcohol causes about 30% of all highway deaths." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Standard Drink Measurements
sections.description: The standard drink measurements were updated from the 2002 figures (4-ounce wine, 1-ounce liquor) to 2026 figures.
bullets: "Five ounce glass of wine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"One and a half ounce serving of 80-proof liquor (even if mixed with a soft drink)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Toll Violations and License Nonrenewal
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the reasons for license nonrenewal to include multi-state E-ZPass/Fast Lane and Tobin Bridge toll violations.
bullets: "Unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Unpaid Tobin Bridge violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Speed Limits
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies minimum speed limits including 20 mph in Boston Harbor tunnels, which is more detailed than the 2002 manual's general 45 mph interstate minimum.
bullets: "There is a minimum speed of 40 mph on the Massachusetts Turnpike. There is a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels (Callahan, Sumner, and Ted Williams)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Speed and Pedestrian Injury Statistics
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific statistics on pedestrian injury/fatality rates at various speeds not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "At a speed of 20 mph, 13% of pedestrians are seriously injured or killed in a crash. At 30 mph, that increases to 40% and at 40 mph it increases to 73%." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Thickly Settled 25 mph Speed Limit
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph per statute, not addressed in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) Course
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a SCARR course requirement for certain junior operator speeding and drag racing convictions not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "All offenses require a new learner’s permit exam, a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course, and a new road test. In addition, you may be re quired to take a State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Reinstatement Hearings by Phone
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the hearing process to be conducted by phone rather than the walk-in branch hearings described in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Visit Mass.Gov/RMV for hearing information and to schedule a hearing. The Hearings Officer will then call you and conduct the hearing by phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow Signal
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a flashing yellow arrow signal type that did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic. You must carefully determine that there is an adequate gap in the oncoming traffic and ensure that there are no pedestrians in your path before making your turn." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon, a new pedestrian-activated signal not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system. They are often located in intersections without traffic signals or at mid-block crosswalks. When activated, amber lights flash in an irregular pattern. You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon, a new signal type not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) allows pedestrians to safely cross a roadway. A PHB only operates when activated by a pedestrian. When all lights are dark, you can proceed with caution. When the bottom yellow light is flashing, you must slow down. When the bottom yellow light is solid, you must prepare to stop. When the top two red lights are solid, you must stop for pedestrians. When the top two red lights are flashing, you must stop and proceed with caution if clear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds bicycle-specific traffic signals not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols. When the signal is green, bicyclists can go through busy intersections while motor vehicles are stopped, protecting them from turning vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Signal Countdown Timer
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands pedestrian signal rules to include a numeric countdown timer not described in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Some crosswalk signals include a numeric countdown timer. Pedestrians who are already in the crosswalk when the countdown reaches zero have the right-of-way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yielding to Pedestrians When Turning into Driveway or Parking Lot
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a driver requirement to yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot, which was not listed in the 2002 laws for drivers.
bullets: "You must yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows) pavement markings not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Shared Lane Markings (also known as Sharrows) help bicyclists position themselves in the right location and in the right direction in a lane that is shared with motor vehicles. By following these markings, bicyclists can avoid being hit by the open door of a parked vehicle or getting squeezed next to a motor vehicle in a narrow lane. When you see a Shared Lane Marking, you must look out for the presence of bicyclists and make sure that you leave them enough space when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds bicycle lane pavement markings and rules not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide. Motor vehicles may only drive in these lanes when turning on or off the road. Before crossing a bicycle lane, you must look carefully for bicyclists, and you must cross with care." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds advisory bicycle lanes not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic. They are dashed on one or both sides to indicate that motor vehicles may use the lane space when necessary, but they must always yield to bicyclists first." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Pavement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds green pavement markings for bicycle conflict areas not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Green pavement is used in areas where there could be road sharing conflicts between motor vehicles and bicycles. You should pay close attention and look for bicyclists before crossing green pavement. At a red light, you should not stop on green pavement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes (Red Pavement)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds red pavement bus lanes not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems. This includes buses, streetcars, trolleys, light-rail trains, and rapid transit fleets." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yield Lines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds yield line pavement markings not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "An intersection with a yield sign may have a YIELD line painted across it. A YIELD line looks like a series of triangles painted next to each other." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Channelizing Islands
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds channelizing islands not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "A channelizing island is a traffic island or pavement marking that guides traffic along certain paths and prevents operation on areas of the roadway. You cannot drive over or park a motor vehicle upon any channelizing island, unless directed to do so by a police officer." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Crossing Guards
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated crossing guards section with safety guidance not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "In recent years, several crossing guards in Massachusetts have been killed or injured while on duty when struck by vehicles. As a driver, you should look for warning signs that crossing guards and children may be in the road and be prepared to stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Flaggers in Work Zones
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands work zone guidance to include civil flaggers and detailed traffic control device instructions beyond the 2002 manual's flag person/police officer references.
bullets: "Civil Flaggers are typically used on low-speed, low-volume roadways to control traffic movement around the work area and to support other road users navigate the area." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: A new law requiring drivers to move over or slow down when approaching stationary emergency vehicles.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires that if you are approaching a stationary emergency vehicle and it is displaying its flashing lights, you must proceed with caution and reduce your speed to that of a reasonable and safe speed for the road conditions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Point Turns
sections.description: A new section describing how to perform a three-point turn when there is not enough room for a U-turn.
bullets: "When there is not enough room for a U-turn, you may consider a three- point turn. This will put you in the opposite direction." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: A new section providing steps for backing up safely.
bullets: "Shift into reverse and start backing up, while looking over your right shoulder. Ensure a safe and smooth speed while maintaning your lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Roundabouts
sections.description: A new section describing roundabouts, which differ from rotaries in size and speed.
bullets: "Roundabouts are similar to rotaries. They are generally much smaller than rotaries and have a smaller central barrier." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: A new section warning about crashes caused by drivers waving others through traffic.
bullets: "Sometimes, drivers trying to be nice can cause confusion resulting in "courtesy crashes". Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Passing Stopped Vehicles
sections.description: A new section warning against passing stopped or turning vehicles.
bullets: "Do not pass vehicles that are stopped or are turning (both at intersections and at non-intersections). They may be stopped for another vehicle, a person, or an animal that you cannot see." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: School Bus Stopping Violation Penalty
sections.description: The fine for failing to stop for a school bus increased from up to $200 to $250.
bullets: "A first violation of this law can cause a license suspension and a $250 fine." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: White Cane Law for Visually Impaired Pedestrians
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the named White Cane Law and explicit instructions about not honking or waving on a blind pedestrian.
bullets: "The White Cane Law states that a driver must come to a complete stop when a blind pedestrian is crossing a street." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Reporting Aggressive Drivers
sections.description: The number to report dangerous drivers changed from *77 to 911.
bullets: "If you have a cell phone, call the State Policeat 911 to report an emergency situation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Processions
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands funeral procession rules with a definition, statutory citation, right-of-way provisions, and intersection rules not present in 2002.
bullets: "Funeral processions have the right-of-way at intersections, with the EXCEPTION that they must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens or when directed by law enforcement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rules for Driving in a Funeral Procession
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed rules for vehicles participating in a funeral procession, which the 2002 manual did not include (it only addressed yielding to processions).
bullets: "Not drive faster than 55 MPH on a highway with a speed limit of 55 MPH or higher. You must also not go more than 5 MPH slower than the speed limit on any other public way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Doubled Fines for Speeding in Work Areas
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that speeding fines are doubled in work areas, which was not stated in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "If you are cited for speeding in a “work area”, the fine will be doubled ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalty for Parking in a Bus Stop
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 penalty for parking in a posted bus stop, which was not stated in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "In a bus stop (the penalty for parking in a posted bus stop is $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prohibition on Parking in a Bicycle Lane
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds parking in a bicycle lane to the list of prohibited parking locations, which was not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "In a bicycle lane" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fine for Wrongful Use of Disabled Parking
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies fines of $300 for first offense and a minimum $500 for wrongful use of disabled plates/placards, which the 2002 manual did not specify.
bullets: "The fine for a first offense is $300. The fine for wrongful use of a disabled person or veteran plate or placard is a minimum of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prohibition on Parking on the Massachusetts Turnpike
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds parking on the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines $15-$100) to the list of prohibited locations, which was not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "On the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines range from $15 - $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prohibition on Parking in Crosshatch Area Next to HP-DV Space
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits parking in a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, which the 2002 manual did not address.
bullets: "In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law for Stationary Emergency Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the move-over law requiring drivers to change lanes and slow down for stationary emergency vehicles, which was not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires you to be cautious and reduce your speed to a speed that is reasonable and safe for the road conditions when you approach a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing lights." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Expanded Bicyclist Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual greatly expands bicycle laws based on Chapter 525 of the Acts of 2008, including full-lane use, helmet requirements for under-16, equipment requirements, and crash reporting.
bullets: "You can use the full lane anywhere, anytime, and on any street (except limited access or express state highways where signs specifically prohibiting bicycles have been posted), even if there is a bike lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"A bicycle helmet approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission must be worn by a bicycle operator or passenger under 16 years old." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Four-Foot Passing Distance for Bicycles
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires motorists to stay at least four feet away when passing a bicycle, which was not specified in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Open Door Danger and Dutch Reach Method
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance on the danger of open vehicle doors to bicyclists and introduces the Dutch Reach method, with fines for dooring.
bullets: "Drivers and passengers can be fined up to $100 for opening a vehicle door into an oncoming bicycle. (Chap. 90, Sec 14)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Boxes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for bicycle boxes at intersections, which did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Drivers must stop behind the bicycle box (even when it's empty) and wait for a green light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Separated Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for separated bicycle lanes (cycle tracks/protected bike lanes), which were not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Separated bicycle lanes, also know as cycle tracks and protected bike lanes, physically separate bicycle traffic from vehicular traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Through Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on tunnel safety procedures that did not exist in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Public Safety is a priority at MassDOT. Please follow these important safety tips when traveling through our tunnels." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drive Smart and Save - Green Driving Tips
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on fuel-saving and eco-friendly driving tips not present in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "There are a lot of ways you can save money on gas and reduce your carbon footprint, and you can do it with any vehicle!" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Leaving the Scene Without Identifying Yourself
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific criminal penalties for leaving the scene of a crash, which were not detailed in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "Up to $5000 and imprisonment of up to 2 ½ years in jail or up to 10 years in state prison for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person that resulted in death (Section 2 (a ½) (2))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Breakdown Safety Equipment Placement
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies new warning triangle/LED flare placement distances and a safety vest procedure, differing from the 2002 manual's single 200-foot flare placement.
bullets: "If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet in front of your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Driver Removal Law requirement to move vehicles out of travel lanes after a property-damage crash, which is not in the 2002 manual.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Stalling on Railroad Tracks - Emergency Notification System
sections.description: The 2026 manual updates the railroad track stall procedure to direct callers to the Emergency Notification System number on the crossbuck rather than simply calling police.
bullets: "If you cannot move your vehicle from the tracks, call the toll free Emergency Notification System (ENS) number that is located in the middle of the crossbuck or on the metal box near the grade crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Repairable Title
sections.description: The 2002 explanation of how a vehicle is declared a total loss due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or other events is absent from the 2026 manual text.
bullets: "If your vehicle becomes inoperable due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or another event to such an extent that you or, if insured, your insurer considers it uneconomical to repair the vehicle, the vehicle will be declared a total loss." (2002 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
